|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[I'm Ready For Anything]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. The current text is [[I'm Ready For Anything (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' (this page): Players Committee card image first published 2 October 2023<ref name="ht-88182de">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual22-Light/large/imreadyforanything.gif</code> as published 2 October 2023: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/88182de5459f1ffeeb3856f4ece24e2f4c6a7437/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Light/large/imreadyforanything.gif holotable commit 88182de] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “USED: For remainder of turn, each player may only fire one weapon at each Cantina or [Reflections II] site. OR If your Mara in battle, add 1 to a just drawn battle destiny (2 if at a [Reflections II] site). LOST: Deploy Mara and a lightsaber simultaneously from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[I'm Ready For Anything (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 4, file created 6 October 2023: “USED: For remainder of turn, each player may only fire one weapon at each Cantina or [Reflections II] site. OR If your Mara in battle, add 1 to a just drawn battle destiny (2 if at a [Reflections II] site). LOST: Deploy Mara and a lightsaber simultaneously from hand and/or Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[I'm Ready For Anything]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[I'm Ready For Anything]] (published 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•I’m Ready For Anything”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
